name: Lost Necklace
summary: In southern Elwynn, Bernice Stonefield looks for her missing necklace. She suspects Billy Maclure, the young son of the family across the road, and asks you to find him.

sections.title: A Neighborly Accusation
sections.body: The Stonefields and Maclures live on adjoining land in southern Elwynn Forest, but goodwill between them is scarce. When “Auntie” Bernice Stonefield finds her cherished necklace missing, she blames the youngest Maclure. Certain Billy Maclure came onto her farm and took it, the bitter widow asks you to cross the road to the vineyards, find the boy, and demand its return.

sections.title: A Boy with an Appetite
sections.body: At the neighboring vineyard, Billy Maclure denies taking the necklace and says he is no thief. With a knowing grin, he hints that he may know where it went. First, he wants someone to satisfy his hunger with a fresh pork pie.

faq.answer: Auntie Bernice Stonefield is an elderly widow who lives on Stonefield Farm in southern Elwynn Forest. She distrusts the neighboring Maclure family, especially their troublemaking young son, Billy.

faq.q: Did Billy Maclure actually steal the necklace?
faq.answer: Billy Maclure firmly denies stealing the necklace. He hints that he knows who took it, but will not share what he knows until someone feeds him.

faq.q: Where can I find Billy Maclure?
faq.answer: You can find Billy Maclure among the grapevines at Maclure Vineyards, just east across the road from Stonefield Farm.

faq.q: Why do the Stonefields and Maclures dislike each other?
aliases: why do they hate each other
faq.answer: The neighboring Stonefield and Maclure families have been caught in a bitter rural feud for years. Property, pride, and old personal grudges keep tensions high, so each side suspects the worst of the other.

faq.q: What happens after talking to Billy Maclure?
faq.answer: Billy says he is too hungry to remember where the necklace went. He sends you back to Auntie Bernice to bake him a pork pie in exchange for the information.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You travel through southern Elwynn Forest between Stonefield Farm and the adjoining Maclure Vineyards.

angles.text: As an Alliance novice in Elwynn Forest, you get a taste of frontier life by settling a petty dispute between the squabbling Stonefield and Maclure families.
As a human, you see that strife in the Kingdom of Stormwind comes not only from Defias outlaws and gnoll warbands. Old quarrels between rural neighbors run deep, too.
